title: Helm OCI index reconciler and gated upgrade hooks for private installer
author: Sofia Patel
description:
Context: Private installer upgrades for air-gapped/VPC deployments require a robust Helm index that can be reconciled from OCI registries and a gated upgrade hook to prevent partial upgrades when provenance is missing. This PR implements an OCI index reconciler service, adds preflight/gated upgrade Helm hooks, and wires release provenance checks into the chart release pipeline. Motivation: reduce upgrade failure blast radius in on-prem environments, make release manifests verifiable out-of-band, and automate index/manifest reconciliation for staggered airgap imports.

What this PR does:
- Adds a small Go reconciler (cmd/oci-index-reconciler) that consumes chart blobs from OCI, verifies signatures (cosign) and produces an index.yaml compatible with helm serve/registry use cases.
- Introduces a preflight Job template (templates/preflight-provenance-job.yaml) that runs in-cluster during helm upgrade --install and rejects the release if release-manifest provenance is not present.
- Adds a Helm hook (templates/upgrade-gate-hook.yaml) that gates canary/primary rollouts until the reconciler confirms artifact presence in the local OCI mirror.
- Extends CI: ci/release/provenance-verify.yaml which generates and publishes signed release-manifests and stores provenance metadata in the OCI artifact index.

Backward compatibility: the reconciler can be toggled off via chart values.reconciler.enabled=false; default behavior remains unchanged for existing hosted users.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests for reconciler (internal indexing logic)
- [x] Integration test for preflight job (ci/integration/preflight_test.go)
- [x] CI step to publish signed manifests and attach provenance
- [x] Documentation updates (docs/helm/releases.md) describing on-prem workflow

Notes: see linked Linear ENG-9128 for rollout plan and ENG-9250 for operator runbook. This description contains the full changelist and rationale.
